row_alignment: exactly the input rows, keys and order of detector_input.parquet
time_semantics: UTC, end of the measured hour (as in the input)
causality: a feature at time t uses only rows of the same station with time <= t
fitting: all parameters fitted on the train partition only; no labels used

sp_dtheta_dry_5.meaning: Hourly first difference of SOIL_MOISTURE_5, kept only when rain over the last 3 h (P_CALC, incl. t) < 0.5 mm, else 0. Unexplained dry-weather jumps.
sp_dtheta_dry_5.nan_rule: NaN if SOIL_MOISTURE_5 at t or t-1 is NaN, or any rain value in t-2..t is NaN

sp_dtheta_dry_10.meaning: Hourly first difference of SOIL_MOISTURE_10, kept only when rain over the last 3 h (P_CALC, incl. t) < 0.5 mm, else 0. Unexplained dry-weather jumps.
sp_dtheta_dry_10.nan_rule: NaN if SOIL_MOISTURE_10 at t or t-1 is NaN, or any rain value in t-2..t is NaN

sp_innov_5.meaning: Observed minus drydown prediction theta_r + (theta_prev - theta_r)*exp(-m/tau) + rain response, iterated from the last valid observation m <= 6 h earlier.
sp_innov_5.window: last valid observation within 6 h, rain since then
sp_innov_5.nan_rule: NaN if SOIL_MOISTURE_5 at t is NaN, no valid value in the previous 6 h (filter reset), or rain missing in the bridged hours

sp_innov_10.meaning: Observed minus drydown prediction theta_r + (theta_prev - theta_r)*exp(-m/tau) + rain response, iterated from the last valid observation m <= 6 h earlier.
sp_innov_10.window: last valid observation within 6 h, rain since then
sp_innov_10.nan_rule: NaN if SOIL_MOISTURE_10 at t is NaN, no valid value in the previous 6 h (filter reset), or rain missing in the bridged hours

sp_innov_z_5.meaning: sp_innov_5 / (1.4826 * train MAD of the innovation), station-specific.

sp_innov_z_10.meaning: sp_innov_10 / (1.4826 * train MAD of the innovation), station-specific.

sp_cusum_5.meaning: Two-sided CUSUM max(S+, S-) of sp_innov_z_5 with train-fitted drift k_c. State is held (not updated) while 3 h rain >= 0.5 mm or rain unknown, for at most the station's train-fitted cusum_max_hold_hours per spell (P_CALC is attackable), and reset to 0 after more than 6 h without a valid z. Compare with threshold h.
sp_cusum_5.nan_rule: NaN where sp_innov_z_5 is NaN (state unchanged)

sp_cusum_10.meaning: Two-sided CUSUM max(S+, S-) of sp_innov_z_10 with train-fitted drift k_c. State is held (not updated) while 3 h rain >= 0.5 mm or rain unknown, for at most the station's train-fitted cusum_max_hold_hours per spell (P_CALC is attackable), and reset to 0 after more than 6 h without a valid z. Compare with threshold h.
sp_cusum_10.nan_rule: NaN where sp_innov_z_10 is NaN (state unchanged)

sp_depth_gap.nan_rule: NaN if either depth is NaN at t

sp_depth_xcorr.meaning: Max over lags L = 0..6 h of the Pearson correlation between diff(SM5) at t-L and diff(SM10) at t (10 cm lagging), over a trailing window.
sp_depth_xcorr.nan_rule: NaN if either depth is NaN at t, fewer than 48 pairs, or zero variance

sp_replay_match.meaning: 1 if the trailing 12 h window of (SM5, SM10, P_CALC), rounded to sensor precision (0.001 m3/m3, 0.1 mm), exactly equals an earlier window of the same station. Windows with any NaN or a flat SM5 or SM10 are skipped (never match).
sp_replay_match.window: 12 h trailing vs. all earlier windows of the station
sp_replay_match.nan_rule: Never NaN: 0 when the window is ineligible (contains NaN or is flat)

sp_replay_run.meaning: Consecutive hours with sp_replay_match = 1, up to and including t.

sp_rough_5.meaning: Trailing std (ddof=1) of the second difference of SOIL_MOISTURE_5: noise texture. Injected ramps/plateaus are too smooth; spikes are too rough.
sp_rough_5.nan_rule: NaN if SOIL_MOISTURE_5 at t is NaN or fewer than 18 valid values

sp_rough_10.meaning: Trailing std (ddof=1) of the second difference of SOIL_MOISTURE_10: noise texture. Injected ramps/plateaus are too smooth; spikes are too rough.
sp_rough_10.nan_rule: NaN if SOIL_MOISTURE_10 at t is NaN or fewer than 18 valid values
